diagnosis: The Prisma $use middleware uses Object.assign({ tenantId: userTenantId }, params.args.where). Because params.args.where is passed as the second argument, any client query parameter containing tenantId overrides the injected userTenantId. An attacker can append ?tenantId=<victim_tenant_id> to the query string to access all client sales contracts and valuation terms of another tenant.
exploit_request:
GET /api/contracts?tenantId=tenant_competitor_8819 HTTP/1.1
Host: crm.contracts.internal:3037
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_attacker_jwt>
Accept: application/json
